items.title: Replacement motor rules may affect the available options
items.body: When a pump or motor decision is already in front of you, compare the repair and replacement paths using the exact equipment and job figures. Do not tell a customer that every working single-speed pump must be replaced.

source.label: U.S. Department of Energy - Dedicated-Purpose Pool Pump Motors

items.guardrail: Standards and enforcement timing vary by motor size, manufacturing date, product class, and other facts. Confirm current official guidance and manufacturer documentation before making a compliance statement.

items.title: Before you leave the pump
items.body: Capture both plates, THP, voltage, speed type, plumbing size, and one wide equipment-pad photo before quoting or ordering.
items.guardrail: A proof checklist supports verification. It does not confirm fitment or diagnose the equipment.

items.title: Connected pumps are becoming service signals
items.body: For an IntelliFlo3 or IntelliPro3 VSF pump, capture the pump plate, drive/app alert, speed or flow schedule, water-turnover context, filter pressure, water level, and automation or RS-485/I-O board photo before quoting, escalating, or recommending a change.

source.label: Pentair IntelliFlo3 VSF product and Pool Brain integration pages

items.guardrail: Use this as market and proof intelligence only. It does not diagnose the pump, confirm a repair/replacement decision, imply SplashLens has live Pentair telemetry, or imply any Pool Brain or Pentair endorsement.
